proposal.reason: Main change is in network: NET/CollNet backend selection and plugin lifetime move from global to per-communicator state, and NET/proxy paths now execute via communicator-selected backends (including proxy batching/shutdown behavior). communicator is additionally needed because init/free/split lifecycle now owns netName config, backend compatibility checks for shared parent/child communicators, and per-comm finalize semantics. device-topology is additionally needed because NIC discovery/topology construction now depends on communicator-selected NET/CollNet backends and per-topology EIC mode. graph-search is additionally needed because PXN disable and graph comparison decisions were changed to be communicator/topology-specific (per-backend behavior), affecting channel/path selection logic.
